status: Finite actual-commit serial history and aborted-event exclusion checked; constructive successful executions and original-protocol counterexample remain pending
evidence_class: Handwritten transaction-model proof, with reviewed Rust/SQL mapping and separate native regression; not asynchronous Rust/SQL extraction or formal refinement

claims.committing_effect: Every reached commit request has the independent sequential replica or replacement effect. Original request, program choice, staging completeness and current observations are derived from the execution.
claims.execution_serial: Every finite fixed-protocol execution produces the independent sequential operations in its actual server-commit event order, normalizing only disjoint frame changes.
claims.aborted_event_excluded: No actual commit event has an aborted attempt identity; this does not exclude equal pre-existing rows or another attempt producing equal values.
claims.serial_history_and_abort: The same reached state satisfies both serial-history equivalence and exclusion of the given aborted attempt.

development_repairs: Request preservation needed explicit normalization of equal transaction indices.
